 Former president Obama & VP Harris, President Trump to campaign in GA
 Former Vice President Kamala Harris and former President Barack Obama are campaigning across Georgia ahead of the midterm elections. President Trump is scheduled to hold a rally in Macon as well. We are also breaking down the 4 amendments on the Georgia ballot.
